protocol.question: Equal-output finite fibers, incremental SMT, and direct residual diagnosis on native and complete-domain challenge observations

selection.control_order: ascending SHA256 of canonical JSON normalized query, then class ID
selection.query_order: ascending class ID in saved table mask-first observation census
selection.rationale: The four weakening targets were selected in the prior perspective review because all 16 two-block robust classes occur there. All insufficient classes and fixed status controls are included before any new timing. This is discovery-followup challenge selection, not a representative edit distribution.

coverage.saved_table_census: All 80 single edits by all 10,436 old-valid procurement observation classes, 834,880 target-class rows; record safe/stale/insufficient and complete robust family.
coverage.independent_raw_census: Recompute all 8,612 old and each target truth labels using independent raw predicates and every observation classification/robust family; no saved labels supplied to this calculation.
coverage.three_engine_crosscheck: All 2,535 insufficient target-class rows across 80 edits plus up to 16 safe and 16 stale controls for every edit, chosen by the frozen hash rule. This is a subset, not all 834,880 engine executions.

workloads.native_unique: Existing seven models, all 20 procurement or 805/535/2085 EPCIS old-valid query classes; no result-cache reuse.
workloads.native_weighted: Existing 50,931 original procurement receipts per target, or 324/216/648 authored EPCIS state occurrences. Semantic class reports may be cached identically; literal reports are lifted and serialized on every occurrence.
workloads.challenge_unique: Four existing weakening targets: every insufficient old-valid observation and up to 16 safe plus 16 stale hash-selected controls. Unique classes only; full 10,436-class census is reported separately. These frequencies are not empirical.

protocol.output_contract: Same strict common query validation, semantic old-receipt sufficiency/verdict check, status, opposed new witnesses, complete minimal robust additional sets, per-request literal lifting, and canonical JSON serialization. Old verdict never constrains the new completion domain. Witnesses need not be byte-identical but all are checked independently.

timing.order: Rotate the 18 model/workload cells each round and cyclically rotate the three methods by round and cell position, sequential fresh child jobs.
timing.process: One fresh child per method/cell/round; pin to minimum available CPU; process_time_ns and perf_counter_ns.
timing.input_loading: Prepared JSON, catalog and raw receipt file reading outside generation timer, measured separately.
timing.input_normalization: Outside generation timer, reconstruct every procurement native request using receipt_key, validate and check its prepared class, or strictly validate prepared finite-domain queries. Record separately; parsing, external acquisition and durable writes are not production latency.
timing.setup: Engine construction included. Additional cold z3 import separately measured and included; core subtracts only this import.
timing.first_report: First request including diagnosis, per-request literal witness lifting and serialization; setup-inclusive and exclusive times recorded.
timing.batch: Setup plus requests, strict shared query validation for each diagnosed class, same semantic cache policy, per-request literal lifting and canonical serialization. Input preparation and durable writes excluded.
timing.validation: Independent exhaustive raw oracle after batch; all unique emitted diagnostic reports verified and native literal witnesses rechecked per request; timed digest replayed. This optional research oracle is measured separately.
timing.statistics: Five actual measured rows per cell/method; medians, per-round paired differences, and generation-plus-oracle sums formed within each round before median. No population inference or retrospective exclusion.
timing.memory: Absolute process ru_maxrss in KiB before setup/after setup/after first/after batch, before research oracle. Not engine-only allocation.

protocol.freeze: Prepare captures protocol, source and input hashes before timing; run accepts only matching frozen files and a fresh output directory. Any correction requires a fresh run, retaining prior evidence.
protocol.limits: Complete finite Cartesian supported domain; profile and whole rank vector are blocks. Challenge is bounded to two unread blocks. No production throughput, typical rule-change frequency, optimal adaptive acquisition or multiple robust alternatives claim.
